title.zh: 将Apayao 省 Pudtol 市镇 Cacalaggan 描笼涯的 Matguisi 综合国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Tawit 国立中学，并为此拨付所需经费
title.en: An Act Separating the Matguisi Comprehensive National High School - Cacalaggan Annex in Barangay Cacalaggan, Municipality of Pudtol, Province of Apayao From the Mataguisi Comprehensive National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to Be Known as Tawit National High School and Appropriating Fund Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Matguisi Comprehensive National High School - Cacalaggan Annex in Barangay Cacalaggan, Municipality of Pudtol, Province of Apayao From the Mataguisi Comprehensive National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to Be Known as Tawit National High School and Appropriating Fund Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Cacalaggan của Trường Trung học Toàn diện Matguisi Quốc gia tại Barangay Cacalaggan, Đô thị Pudtol, Tỉnh Apayao khỏi Trường Trung học Toàn diện Mataguisi Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Tawit Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Cacalaggan ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแบบครบวงจร Matguisi แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Cacalaggan เทศบาล Pudtol จังหวัด Apayao ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาแบบครบวงจร Mataguisi แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Tawit แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Cacalaggan, Sekolah Menengah Terpadu Matguisi Nasional di Barangay Cacalaggan, Kotamadya Pudtol, Provinsi Apayao dari Sekolah Menengah Terpadu Mataguisi Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Tawit Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Cacalaggan, Sekolah Menengah Menyeluruh Matguisi Kebangsaan di Barangay Cacalaggan, Perbandaran Pudtol, Wilayah Apayao daripada Sekolah Menengah Menyeluruh Mataguisi Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Tawit Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Mataguisi Comprehensive National High School – Cacalaggan Annex in Barangay Cacalaggan, Municipality of Pudtol, Province of Apayao is hereby separated from the Mataguisi Comprehensive National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be kanown as Tawit National High School.
All personnel, assets, liabilities, and records of the Mataguisi Comprehensive National High School – Cacalaggan Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Tawit National High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Tawit National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriation of the Mataguisi Comprehensive National High School – Cacalaggan Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
The Secretary of Education shall formulate the rules and regulations necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act within one hundred twenty (120) days after its effectivity.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
